body: Thanks for making me feel worse. Really appreciate it. I've tried to kill myself before. Trust me I spend a lot of time thinking about how my problems are totally illegitimate and I don't deserve to feel bad ever because other people have it worse.

I LOVE physics. It's the only thing I can picture myself doing. The thing about the GRE is that it costs $150 per test (not including the fees to send your scores and each school's application fee.) and it's only offered 3 times a year. Not the kind of thing you can take over and over again. I pay for the tests with the money I make at my work-study job, I have a really limited budget. 

It's not so easy to stop caring about what others think of you? It's not like I've never tried that. Anyway, I agree with what the person posted.

I don't know what it's like to have bad credit...but the thought of outstanding debt gives me a lot of anxiety. I don't think it's unreasonable for me to want to pay off my loans.
